candidate_program.name: bounded_compatible_peak_horizon
candidate_program.rationale: Adds a small bounded bonus for preserving a heavy compatible contact, moderated by the root's reward relative to its strongest rival. This reaches the global compatible residual through maximum scans; per-root filtering costs linear work and omits longer completion interactions.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.08 * compatible_peak_fraction * weight / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
